# HOP DONG BAO HIEM TAI SAN

## (BAO HIEM MOI RUI RO TAI SAN)

TEN TO CHUC (BEN A)  CONG TY TNHH XAY DUNG VA  DIA CHI  211 LY THUONG KIET

THUONG MAI PHUONG NAM

MA SO THUE  3500237982  DIEN THOAI  0922143672

TEN TO CHUC (BEN B)  CONG TY CP BAO HIEM NHAN  DIA CHI  SO 135 GIAI PHONG, PHUONG 11, PHU

THO AN PHUC  NHUAN, TPHCM

DIEN THOAI  0498115345

MAY MOC, DAY CHUYEN THIET BI SAN XUAT  15,500,000,000

HANG HOA, NGUYEN VAT LIEU TRONG KHO  6,000,000,000

TONG CONG  21,500,000,000

1) BEN B BOI THUONG CHO NHUNG TON THAT VAT CHAT BAT NGO VA KHONG LUONG TRUOC DUOC XAY RA DOI VOI TAI

SAN DUOC BAO HIEM, TRU CAC TRUONG HOP LOAI TRU TRACH NHIEM BAO HIEM QUY DINH TAI QUY TAC BAO HIEM MOI

RUI RO TAI SAN DINH KEM.

2) MUC KHAU TRU: 50.000.000 DONG CHO MOI VA MOI VU TON THAT. PHI BAO HIEM THANH TOAN MOT LAN BANG

CHUYEN KHOAN TRONG VONG 20 NGAY KE TU NGAY KY HOP DONG.

3) BEN A CO TRACH NHIEM KE KHAI DAY DU, TRUNG THUC; AP DUNG CAC BIEN PHAP DE PHONG, HAN CHE TON THAT;

KHI XAY RA SU KIEN BAO HIEM, THONG BAO NGAY CHO BEN B TRONG VONG 24 GIO VA GIU NGUYEN HIEN TRUONG.

4) BEN B CAP GIAY CHUNG NHAN BAO HIEM SAU KHI BEN A DA DONG DU PHI; BOI THUONG TRONG VONG 15 NGAY KE

TU NGAY NHAN DU HO SO HOP LE.

5) MOI TRANH CHAP TRUOC HET GIAI QUYET BANG THUONG LUONG; KHONG THUONG LUONG DUOC THI DUA RA TOA

AN CO THAM QUYEN TAI VIET NAM.

DAI DIEN BEN A  DAI DIEN BEN B

(KY, GHI RO HO TEN VA DONG  (KY, GHI RO HO TEN VA DONG

DAU)  DAU)

LUU Y: DE NGHI BEN MUA BAO HIEM KY DUNG VOI CHU KY DA DANG KY GIAO DICH VOI CONG TY
